name: soapbox-pub/nostr-skills
description: A collection of skills for working with the Nostr protocol.

plugins.name: nostr
plugins.description: Knowledge about the Nostr protocol. Use to view up-to-date NIPs, discover capabilities of the Nostr protocol, and to implement Nostr functionality correctly.

plugins.name: nak
plugins.description: Interact with Nostr protocol using the nak CLI tool. Use to generate Nostr secret keys, encode and decode Nostr identifiers (hex/npub/nsec/nip05/etc), fetch events from relays, sign and publish Nostr events, and more.
